verse: For God has revealed his grace for the salvation of all people. That grace instructs us to give up ungodly living and worldly passions, and to live self-controlled, upright, and godly lives in this world, He gave himself for us, to rescue us from all wickedness and to make us a pure people who belong to him alone and are eager to do good.
